### 12. Contract

The contract version this story builds against is the v1 base `/api/recovery/valuation/v1`, the route operation baselined by RWB-S1-E4001-CON. The version number of that contract is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S1-E4007-APP-23).

edits.old: `RouteDecisionWorkflow` is the one workflow the ownership rows give S1, and the two activities are this story's; the remaining activities of the route decision belong to the sibling stories.
edits.new: `RouteDecisionWorkflow` is the one workflow the ownership rows give S1, and the two activities are this story's; the remaining activities of the route decision belong to the sibling stories. Start rule: the workflow is started by `CaseWorkflow` as a child when the case reaches route decision D6 or is reopened (ROUTE_D6_REOPEN), per Temporal Catalog v1. The workflow ID form and the duplicate-start policy are Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-8100).
